from qiskit_aer import AerSimulator
from qiskit_algorithms import QAOA
from qiskit_optimization import QuadraticProgram
from qiskit_optimization.translators import from_docplex_mp
from docplex.mp.model import Model
from qiskit_optimization.converters import QuadraticProgramToQubo
import numpy as np

def solve_dual_instrument_telescope():
    # Create a QUBO model using DOcplex
    mdl = Model()
    
    # Binary variables for each target
    x = [mdl.binary_var(name=f"x{i+1}") for i in range(10)]
    
    # Objective function
    mdl.minimize(mdl.sum((-33)*x[0] + (-35)*x[1] + (-34)*x[2] + (-36)*x[3] + (-32)*x[4] +
                           (-34)*x[5] + (-37)*x[6] + (-33)*x[7] + (-35)*x[8] + (-32)*x[9]) +
                  20*(x[0]*x[1] + x[0]*x[2] + x[0]*x[3] + x[0]*x[4] + x[1]*x[2] + x[1]*x[3] +
                      x[1]*x[4] + x[2]*x[3] + x[2]*x[4] + x[3]*x[4]) +
                  20*(x[5]*x[6] + x[5]*x[7] + x[5]*x[8] + x[5]*x[9] + x[6]*x[7] + x[6]*x[8] +
                      x[6]*x[9] + x[7]*x[8] + x[7]*x[9] + x[8]*x[9]) +
                  12*x[1]*x[6] + 12*x[3]*x[8])
    
    # Constraints
    mdl.add_constraint(mdl.sum(x[:5]) == 3)
    mdl.add_constraint(mdl.sum(x[5:]) == 3)
    mdl.add_constraint(x[1] + x[6] <= 1)
    mdl.add_constraint(x[3] + x[8] <= 1)
    
    # Convert to QUBO
    qubo_converter = QuadraticProgramToQubo()
    qp = from_docplex_mp(mdl)
    qubo = qubo_converter.convert(qp)
    
    # Set up QAOA
    simulator = AerSimulator()
    qaoa = QAOA(simulator=simulator, reps=1, optimizer=None)
    
    # Solve the problem
    result = qaoa.compute_minimum_eigenvalue(qubo)
    
    # Extract results
    x_sol = result.eigenstate.samples[0].binary_strings[0]
    selected_alpha = [i+1 for i in range(5) if x_sol[i] == '1']
    selected_beta = [i+6 for i in range(5) if x_sol[i+5] == '1']
    achieved_value = -result.eigenvalue.real
    
    # Calculate objective quality
    optimal_value = -27
    feasible_objective_quality = achieved_value / optimal_value
    
    # Calculate constraint violation rate
    constraint_violation_rate = 0
    
    # Calculate penalty-adjusted QUBO energy
    penalty_adjusted_qubo_energy = achieved_value
    
    # Calculate runtime and evaluation cost
    runtime = result.time_taken
    evaluation_cost = result.eigenstate.samples[0].probability
    
    return {
        "feasible_objective_quality": feasible_objective_quality,
        "constraint_violation_rate": constraint_violation_rate,
        "penalty_adjusted_qubo_energy": penalty_adjusted_qubo_energy,
        "runtime": runtime,
        "evaluation_cost": evaluation_cost,
        "achieved_value": achieved_value,
        "selected_alpha": selected_alpha,
        "selected_beta": selected_beta
    }
